topic.source_contract: air quality LAQM AQMA planning assessment mitigation monitoring

scope_guards: An AQMA boundary is not treated as an automatic refusal or approval.
Modelled concentration is not treated as monitored compliance at an exact receptor.
An air-quality action plan is not treated as delivered mitigation.
National target delivery is not treated as a parcel-specific planning condition.
Area-level background data is not treated as a site-specific dispersion result.
A mitigation proposal is not treated as installed, maintained and effective.
Planning permission is not treated as an environmental permit or emissions authorisation.
No score or promotion is written without exact scheme, receptors, model, decision, secured mitigation and monitoring evidence.
